Klasse DHUtils

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.utils.DHUtils
public final class DHUtils extends Object
Provides finite-field Diffie-Hellman (DH) operations for the RFC 7919 FFDHE-2048, FFDHE-3072, and FFDHE-4096 groups.

All generated key pairs use EncryptionUtils.random; this class does not create an independent random-number generator. DH shared secrets are converted into AES-128 or AES-256 keys with the common HKDF-SHA-256 implementation in EncryptionUtils.

Only the listed, predefined RFC 7919 groups are accepted. This prevents callers from using arbitrary peer-supplied domain parameters. The caller is still responsible for authenticating the complete key-exchange transcript.

1.5.5

  • Methodendetails

    • generateVariables

      public static DHParameterSpec generateVariables(KEYEXCHANGE.DHParameterLength parameterLength) throws InvalidParameterSpecException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException
      Returns the predefined RFC 7919 FFDHE group matching the requested modulus length. The returned specification uses a 256-bit private exponent for FFDHE-2048/3072 and a 304-bit private exponent for FFDHE-4096, as required by the Bouncy Castle provider.
      Parameter:
      parameterLength - requested DH modulus length; must be one of 2048, 3072, or 4096 bits
      Gibt zurück:
      the corresponding validated DH parameter specification
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameterLength is null
      InvalidParameterSpecException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the predefined group lookup does not currently throw this exception
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the predefined group lookup does not currently throw this exception
      NoSuchProviderException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the predefined group lookup does not currently throw this exception

    • generateVariables

      public static DHParameterSpec generateVariables(BigInteger p, BigInteger g) throws InvalidParameterSpecException, NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException
      Reconstructs a DH parameter specification from the supplied modulus and generator, but only if both values exactly match one of the supported RFC 7919 FFDHE groups.
      Parameter:
      p - public prime modulus of the DH group
      g - public generator belonging to the DH group
      Gibt zurück:
      the validated parameter specification with a group-appropriate private exponent length
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either argument is null or the pair does not match a supported RFC 7919 group
      InvalidParameterSpecException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the supported group lookup does not currently throw this exception
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the supported group lookup does not currently throw this exception
      NoSuchProviderException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility; the supported group lookup does not currently throw this exception

    • generateKeyPair

      public static KeyPair generateKeyPair(DHParameterSpec parameterSpec) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidParameterSpecException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Generates a DH key pair for a previously validated parameter specification. The shared EncryptionUtils.random instance supplies all random bytes.
      Parameter:
      parameterSpec - validated parameters for one of the supported RFC 7919 FFDHE groups
      Gibt zurück:
      newly generated DH public/private key pair
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the parameters are null, unsupported, or specify an insufficient private exponent length
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if the configured provider does not implement DH
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable
      InvalidParameterSpecException - retained in the method signature for API compatibility
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the provider rejects the supplied parameters

    • combineSalts

      public static byte[] combineSalts(byte[] saltClient, byte[] saltServer) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
      Combines the two independently generated DH salts using SHA-256. The order is significant and must be identical at both endpoints: client salt first, server salt second. Each input salt must contain exactly EncryptionUtils.SALT_LENGTH_BYTES bytes, as required by the SEDAP-Express profile.
      Parameter:
      saltClient - fresh 32-byte salt sent by the client
      saltServer - fresh 32-byte salt sent by the server
      Gibt zurück:
      SHA-256 digest of saltClient || saltServer, suitable as the HKDF salt
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either salt is null or not exactly 32 bytes
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if SHA-256 is unavailable from the runtime

    • getSharedSecretKeyHKDFSHA256

      public static byte[] getSharedSecretKeyHKDFSHA256(PrivateKey ownSecretKey, PublicKey otherPublicKey, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidKeyException
      Performs finite-field DH with the supplied local private key and remote public key, then derives an AES-128 or AES-256 key using HKDF-SHA-256. The supplied salt must be the exact same 32-byte value at both peers. For the two-salt DH profile, pass the result of combineSalts(byte[], byte[]).
      Parameter:
      ownSecretKey - local DH private key
      otherPublicKey - remote peer's DH public key
      aesKeyLength - negotiated output AES key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - common 32-byte HKDF salt used by both peers
      Gibt zurück:
      derived AES key, 16 bytes for AES-128 or 32 bytes for AES-256
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if either key has the wrong type, the AES length is null, or the salt is not exactly 32 bytes
      InvalidKeyException - if key parameters differ, are unsupported, or the remote public value is outside the permitted range or the approved subgroup
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if DH, HKDF-SHA-256, or SHA-256 is unavailable
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable

      Löst aus:
